Karaguá Ecotech

One of its primary focuses is converting the conservation of mangroves into economic activities that directly benefit local communities. 

A significant aspect of Karaguá Ecotech's operations involves engagement in the carbon credit market, specifically focusing on blue carbon credits derived from coastal ecosystems. This includes activities such as certifying and selling these carbon credits, conducting environmental monitoring, and executing dedicated mangrove restoration efforts. Through these initiatives, Karaguá Ecotech aims to generate direct financial benefits for coastal communities, encouraging their active participation in the maintenance and enhancement of these crucial ecosystems.

The organization is also known for its collaborative efforts, notably through programs like the PSA Comunitário project, which emphasizes strong partnerships with local governments and community stakeholders. This collaboration fosters community engagement through various technological and educational initiatives that improve environmental conditions and promote local involvement. Furthermore, it serves as the cultural arm of initiatives promoting environmental preservation while integrating technology and culture.

Mapa de Declaração de Segurança Ambiental is a document that validated the location choice for the project's operation by analyzing environmental conditions.

Grupo Pro Babitonga
Grupo Pro Babitonga is an organization that provides data on the ecosystem of Baía da Babitonga.

Ecosystem Services
Ecosystem services refer to the benefits provided by natural environments, which in this case include a financial estimate for estuarine areas.

Revista CEPSUL / ICMBio
Revista CEPSUL / ICMBio is a publication that includes an analysis titled "Os manguezais e marismas da Baía Babitonga: uma síntese."

Boto-Cinza
Boto-Cinza, or Sotalia guianensis, is a threatened species that inhabits the waters of Baía da Babitonga.<SEP>Boto-Cinza is an endangered marine species found in the Baía da Babitonga.

NSC Total
NSC Total is a media organization that reported on Baía da Babitonga, highlighting issues and developments in the area.

Verra
Verra is the organization that manages the Verified Carbon Standard and provides methodologies for carbon credit certification.<SEP>Verra is an organization that develops methodologies (VM0033 and VM0007) for carbon credit certification.

REDD+
REDD+ refers to efforts to reduce emissions from deforestation and forest degradation, now extended to include coastal wetland activities.<SEP>REDD+ refers to a specific methodology for reducing emissions from deforestation and forest degradation, underlining its technical context.

IoTs
IoTs refer to Internet of Things sensors used for continuous data collection on water parameters.

Tecnologia de Monitoramento
Tecnologia de Monitoramento refers to the tools and systems used for tracking environmental data in the field.

Creditos de Carbono
Credits de Carbono refer to the tradable certificates that represent the right to emit one ton of carbon dioxide or its equivalent in other greenhouse gases.

Acordo de Paris
The Acordo de Paris refers to the international agreement aimed at reducing global warming and among its elements, it considers strategies for conservation including mangroves.

Luiz Inácio Lula da Silva
Luiz Inácio Lula da Silva is the president of Brazil who signed the ProManguezal decree on June 5, 2024.

Decreto nº 12.045/2024
Decreto nº 12.045/2024 is a decree that created the ProManguezal program to ensure the preservation and sustainable use of mangroves in Brazil.

PEPSA
PEPSA is the Programa Estadual de Pagamento por Serviços Ambientais, designed to finance conservation and environmental monitoring activities.<SEP>PEPSA refers to the State Policy of Environmental Services in Santa Catarina, which supports the conservation project.<SEP>PEPSA refers to the environmental legislation of Brazil related to Payments for Environmental Services.

data.entity_name: Declaração de Segurança Ambiental de Balneário Barra do Sul
data.content:
Declaração de Segurança Ambiental de Balneário Barra do Sul
The Declaração de Segurança Ambiental de Balneário Barra do Sul is an environmental safety declaration that guided the operational planning of Karaguá's project.

SBCE
SBCE stands for Sistema Brasileiro de Comércio de Emissões de Gases de Efeito Estufa, a regulatory framework for trade in greenhouse gas emissions in Brazil.

data.entity_name: Programa Estadual de Pagamento por Serviços Ambientais
data.content:
Programa Estadual de Pagamento por Serviços Ambientais
Programa Estadual de Pagamento por Serviços Ambientais is a program created by Lei nº 15.133/2010, focusing on funding for environmental services and community remuneration.

Dia Mundial do Meio Ambiente
Dia Mundial do Meio Ambiente, or World Environment Day, is celebrated on June 5 and was the day ProManguezal was formally signed into existence.

Paar
Paar is the Annual Resource Allocation Plan that includes priorities for climate financing in Brazil.

PNMC
PNMC stands for the National Policy on Climate Change in Brazil, which guides climate financing initiatives.

R$ 400 Milhões
R$ 400 milhões represents the average annual funding available through the Fundo Clima between 2010 and 2023.

R$ 25 Bilhões
R$ 25 bilhões is the amount reached by the Fundo Clima’s portfolio for the biennium 2024/2025.

Empréstimos
Empréstimos refers to loans that are part of the funding structure for projects under the Fundo Clima.

Laboratório de Impressão 3D
Laboratório de Impressão 3D refers to a community laboratory project aimed at technological education and waste repurposing.

Lei Orçamentária Anual
The Lei Orçamentária Anual authorized R$ 42,5 bilhões for the Fundo Clima in 2026, indicating projected support for climate initiatives.

PSA Mechanism
The PSA mechanism connects environmental operations with income generation for local residents and fishermen.

3D Printing Community Laboratory
The 3D printing community laboratory is a technological training initiative that supports innovation without directly depending on carbon agenda.

Local Residents and Fishermen
The PSA mechanism involves local residents and fishermen being compensated for their involvement in monitoring and restoration efforts.

Communities of Fishermen
Communities of fishermen are identified as stakeholders involved in the project with Karaguá Ecotech.

Partnerships
Partnerships refer to the collaboration between various institutions and communities in relation to the activities of Karaguá Ecotech.

Credits de Carbono
Credits de Carbono are carbon credits certified through methodologies that support environmental conservation and restoration efforts.

Equipe Técnica
Equipe Técnica refers to the scientific and operational team responsible for the environmental studies and monitoring in the Karaguá Ecotech project.

Monitoramento Contínuo
Monitoramento Contínuo is a continuous monitoring approach applied by the technical team for environmental data collection and restoration efforts.

Restauracão
Restauracão refers to the efforts made by the Karaguá Ecotech project to restore mangrove ecosystems.

Participação Comunitária
Participação Comunitária denotes the involvement of local residents and fishermen in monitoring and restoration activities of the project.

data.entity_name: Fase 1 - Piloto em Balneário Barra do Sul
data.content:
Fase 1 - Piloto em Balneário Barra do Sul
Fase 1 refers to the initial phase of Karaguá Ecotech's project focusing on validating the operational model in Balneário Barra do Sul.

data.entity_name: Fase 3 - Escala para a Baía da Babitonga
data.content:
Fase 3 - Escala para a Baía da Babitonga
Fase 3 is the scaling phase of the project aimed at replicating the successful model across Baía da Babitonga.

Fase 4 - Plataforma digital pública
Fase 4 involves the future launch of a public digital platform for centralized access to generated project data.

Fase 2 - Restauração ativa
Fase 2 signifies the active restoration phase following the pilot, focusing on planting and training local stakeholders.

R$ 1,2 milhão
R$ 1,2 milhão is specified as the annual revenue target in carbon credits based on the project’s financial projections.

data.entity_name: R$ 1,2 milhão por ano em créditos de carbono
data.content:
R$ 1,2 milhão por ano em créditos de carbono
R$ 1,2 milhão por ano em créditos de carbono is a revenue goal set by Karaguá Ecotech based on the carbon credits generated from the project.

Babitonga
Baía da Babitonga is an area in Santa Catarina identified for the company's expansion.

Crédito de Carbono
A Crédito de Carbono is a verifiable and tradable unit equivalent to one ton of CO₂ reduced, removed, or sequestered.

Impacto Socioambiental
Impacto Socioambiental integrates environmental benefits and social development, characterizing the company's model.

Payment for Environmental Services (PSA)
PSA is a mechanism that directly compensates individuals and groups for conservation, recovery, or improvement of natural environments, implemented at Karaguá for monitoring and restoring mangroves.

Blue Carbon
Blue Carbon refers to carbon stored and sequestered in coastal and marine environments such as mangroves, marshes, and seagrass meadows, which have a high capacity for CO₂ capture.

Carbon Credit
A Carbon Credit is a verifiable and tradable unit representing the reduction, removal, or sequestration of one ton of CO₂ equivalent used by companies and governments for decarbonization strategies.

ESG Strategies
ESG Strategies are corporate approaches towards environmental sustainability, social responsibility, and governance, which involve buying blue carbon credits to offset emissions.

Udesc
Udesc is an educational institution from which some participants of the project are drawn.<SEP>Udesc is an educational institution where young individuals from the territory may be enrolled and eligible for research scholarships within the Laboratório Karaguá Vivo project.<SEP>Udesc is an academic institution whose affiliation is a criterion for scholarship recipients in the workshops.

Oficineiros
Oficineiros refers to instructors responsible for conducting workshops in a project environment.<SEP>Oficineiros are the instructors responsible for leading the workshops.

Laboratório
Laboratório refers to the facility where the prototype is developed and other project activities are carried out.

Bolsistas Mensais
Bolsistas mensais refers to monthly scholarship recipients engaged in a project, including young students.

Protótipo de Ecobarreira
The Protótipo de Ecobarreira refers to a prototype developed by the community aimed at ecological sustainability.

Documentário Cultural
The documentário cultural is a cultural documentary aimed to capture the complete cycle of the ecological barrier development and the related workshops.<SEP>Documentário Cultural is a cultural documentary that documents the various stages of the project and the community's involvement.<SEP>Documentário Cultural is a cultural documentary being produced during the project that captures the lab's activities and outcomes.

Câmera Mirrorless
A Câmera Mirrorless is a type of camera used for high-quality video recording in the documentary.

Microfones
Microfones, including wireless and directional types, are used for capturing audio in the documentary.

Cartões SD e SSD Externo
Cartões SD e SSD Externo are storage devices used for archiving video footage over a span of 12 months.

Tripé e Estabilizador
Tripé e Estabilizador, such as a gimbal, are used for stabilizing shots during recordings in various settings.

Iluminação LED Portátil
Iluminação LED Portátil is portable lighting equipment used for recording inside the laboratory.

Custos Administrativos e Contábeis
Custos Administrativos e Contábeis refers to administrative and accounting costs associated with managing the project.

Captação de Recursos
Captação de Recursos involves fundraising activities for the project through partnerships with companies focused on ESG and decarbonization.<SEP>Captação de Recursos refers to the process of fundraising for the project, with a specific target of R$ 34.467 over 36 months.

Laboratório Karaguá Vivo
Laboratório Karaguá Vivo is a cultural community laboratory project focusing on culture, technology, and the preservation of mangroves.<SEP>Laboratório Karaguá Vivo is an initiative aimed at making technology accessible and empowering local residents through digital fabrication, while protecting the coastal ecosystem.<SEP>Laboratório Karaguá Vivo is a cultural project aimed at community education and production involving ecological technologies and methodologies.<SEP>Laboratório Karaguá Vivo is a laboratory that offers six workshops as part of its educational program.<SEP>Laboratório Karaguá Vivo is a community cultural facility focusing on environmental preservation through digital modeling and 3D printing.

Tinkercad
Tinkercad is a free modeling software used in the workshops, accessible through a web browser.<SEP>Tinkercad is a web-based software used for 3D modeling, recommended for beginners participating in design workshops.<SEP>Tinkercad is the suggested free software for modeling workshops, which operates in a web browser without installation.

Formação Cultural e Oficinas
Formação Cultural e Oficinas refers to cultural training and workshops included in the project aimed at community engagement.<SEP>Formação Cultural e Oficinas pertains to cultural training and workshops included in the project's budget with a total of R$ 65.670.

Ecobarreira
Ecobarreira refers to the ecological barrier prototypes developed in the laboratory, focusing on preservation and carbon credits.<SEP>Ecobarreira is a prototype developed during the workshops aimed at environmental preservation, incorporating the use of model-making techniques.<SEP>The ecobarreira is a proposed solution to manage waste in the Canal do Linguado, aimed at addressing waste accumulation in the mangrove area.

Oficinas de Impressão 3D
Oficinas de Impressão 3D are workshops that introduce contemporary digital manufacturing technologies to the community, enhancing local creation and production methods.

João MEI
João MEI is referenced in relation to verifying the cultural CNAE for project compliance with the SALIC.

Lei nº 8.313/1991
Lei nº 8.313/1991 is a cultural law in Brazil that facilitates access to cultural resources and supports initiatives like those taken by Laboratório Karaguá Vivo.

Cultura Digital
Cultura Digital refers to the digital culture promoted through the workshops and activities offered by the Laboratório Karaguá Vivo.

Ensino Inclusivo
Ensino Inclusivo represents the inclusive education framework that focuses on adapting learning opportunities for all community members.

Sustentabilidade
Sustentabilidade refers to the principles of sustainability that are explored through the initiatives of the Laboratório Karaguá Vivo aimed at preserving the environment.

SALIC
SALIC is an organization involved in the logistics of sending materials associated with the Canal do Linguado.

Lucas
Lucas serves as the technical supervisor of the laboratory involved in the Laboratório Karaguá Vivo project.<SEP>Lucas is a person who notes the importance of bringing concepts of prototyping and the creation process into a replicable methodology.

Oficinas de Modelagem
Oficinas de Modelagem refers to modeling workshops for which Tinkercad is suggested as a software tool.

PLA
PLA is a type of filament used in the 3D printing process, discussed in relation to its characteristics compared to PETG.<SEP>PLA is a biodegradable thermoplastic that is often used in 3D printing, discussed in the context of material testing for environmental use.

PETG
PETG is a material highlighted for its properties that make it suitable for the ecobarreira, especially in saline environments.<SEP>PETG is a type of thermoplastic material used in 3D printing, specifically mentioned for its resistance to environmental factors.

Ecobarrier
The ecobarrier is a design project aimed at addressing coastal issues through sustainable materials and engineering solutions.

Workshop 3
Workshop 3 focuses on 3D thinking and digital modeling methods for coastal problem-solving.

Workshop 4
Workshop 4 is centered on product design principles and technical requirements related to coastal environments.

Ecobarrier Design Brief
The Ecobarrier Design Brief outlines the requirements for resistance to current, anchoring, modularity, and environmental impacts.

Impressão 3D
Impressão 3D (3D printing) is a digital fabrication technology introduced in the community to democratize access to innovation and enhance local production capabilities.

Workshop 6
Workshop 6 is intended for validating prototypes with engineers and presenting the results to the community.

Kanaguá Ecotech
Kanaguá Ecotech is the organization associated with engineers providing technical guidance on the ecobarrier project.

Workshop 5
Workshop 5 is focused on manufacturing and assembling the ecobarrier prototypes.

João Pedro
João Pedro is the general coordinator of the laboratory.<SEP>João Pedro is the Coordinator in charge of the laboratory and prototype development for a duration of 12 months.

Lucas Melo
Lucas Melo is the general coordinator responsible for cultural and institutional management in the project.<SEP>Lucas Melo is the General Coordinator of the project responsible for overseeing the Lab’s operations over a 12-month period.

Documentário Cultural (contrapartida)
Documentário Cultural (contrapartida) is a cultural documentary related to the project that has budgeted R$ 28.000 as part of its expenses.

Ecobarreira Prototype
The Ecobarreira Prototype is a development project aimed at environmental preservation, created during the workshops at the laboratory.

Bolsas de Pesquisa
Bolsas de Pesquisa refers to the six research stipends provided for participants working on the ecobarrier prototype’s development.

Infraestrutura do Laboratório
Infraestrutura do Laboratório refers to the laboratory's infrastructure budget, which amounts to R$ 98.800.

Desenvolvimento de Protótipo de Ecobarreira
Desenvolvimento de Protótipo de Ecobarreira is the budgeted concept for developing the ecobarrier prototype, with an allocated amount of R$ 25.000.

Administração e Contabilidade
Administração e Contabilidade refers to the budgetary allocation for administrative and accounting services amounting to R$ 19.200.

João
João is the main proponent of the project, recognized for having the most suitable cultural portfolio.

Curso/Oficina/Capacitação
Curso, oficina, and capacitação refer to the main product of the Laboratório Karaguá Vivo project focusing on cultural and technological education.

5 Objectives
The 5 objectives detail measurable plans for implementing and operating the Laboratório Karaguá Vivo project, including workshops and community engagement.

Espaço Físico
Espaço Físico denotes the physical space that is adapted for access by people with disabilities or reduced mobility.

data.entity_name: Oficina de Cultura Digital e Impressão 3D
data.content:
Oficina de Cultura Digital e Impressão 3D
Oficina de Cultura Digital e Impressão 3D refers to the six free workshops designed to educate residents on digital culture and 3D printing as part of the Laboratório Karaguá Vivo project.

Materiais Didáticos
Materiais Didáticos are educational materials designed to be in simple and accessible language for cognitive accessibility.

Monitoria Especializada
Monitoria Especializada refers to specialized and inclusive monitoring focused on participants with intellectual disabilities or Autism Spectrum Disorder (TEA).

Documentário
Documentário is a cultural documentary featuring subtitles in Portuguese and audio description, aimed at accessibility.<SEP>Documentário refers to the documentary being created to capture the project's process and participant experiences.

Materiais de Divulgação Digital
Materiais de Divulgação Digital are digital promotional materials that include alternative texts and accessible formats.

Ação Cultural
Ação Cultural involves a free cultural event in the city or a defined public space, organized in collaboration with the municipal government.

Registros Audiovisuais
Registros Audiovisuais refers to audiovisual records of activities that include subtitles for accessibility.

Projeto Normal
Projeto Normal is characterized as a project for courses, workshops, and capacity building.

Impressoras 3D
Impressoras 3D are 3D printers used for manufacturing ecobarriers and cultural pieces.

Computadores
Computadores are used in 3D modeling and management of the laboratory.

Filamento PETG e PLA
Filamento PETG e PLA are materials used in workshops for developing prototypes.

Insumos
Insumos refer to supplies, tools, and maintenance materials necessary for workshops.

Ação 1 - Mostra Cultural de Resultados
Ação 1 - Mostra Cultural de Resultados is a free cultural event showcasing eco-barriers and their production process, organized in collaboration with the municipal government.

Ação 2 - Documentário Cultural
Ação 2 - Documentário Cultural is a documentary project that documents the project and territory throughout the 12 months of execution.

Impressora
Impressoras are machines used in the project for printing various components of the ecological barrier prototype.

Ecobarreiras
Ecobarreiras are eco-friendly barriers produced in the laboratory, showcased during the cultural event.<SEP>Ecobarreiras refers to the ecological barriers developed during the project aimed at preserving the coastal ecosystem.

Projeto
Projeto refers to an initiative involving workshops aimed at creating a prototype for environmental solutions over several months.

ProtoTipo
Prototipo refers to the final prototype being developed through the workshops, designed to meet community needs.

Bolsistas
The bolsistas are six participants who act as a bridge between workshops, conducting research and bringing results to the starting point of each new session.<SEP>Bolsistas are participants involved in the workshops, responsible for various tasks including design presentations and fabrication processes.

Mostra Cultural
Mostra Cultural is an event where participants present their work and the prototype to the public.

Círculo de Reflexão
Círculo de Reflexão is an event where participants share insights about their experiences and the impact of the project.

3D Printing Laboratory
The 3D printing laboratory features advanced technology used for fabricating physical objects and is a key component of the workshops.

Oficina 6
Oficina 6 is a workshop focused on finalizing the prototype and presenting it to the community.

Oficina 1
Oficina 1 is a workshop focused on identity territoriality, digital culture, and 3D printing, taking place in Month 2 of the project.

Oficina 2
Oficina 2 is a workshop centered on operating 3D printers, digital literacy, and filament types, occurring in Month 4 of the project.

Camiseta Karaguá
The Camiseta Karaguá is a take-home item provided to participants in the workshops, symbolizing their engagement in the project.

Mês 2 do Projeto
Mês 2 do projeto refers to the second month in the timeline of the project during which Oficina 1 is conducted.

Mês 4 do Projeto
Mês 4 do projeto indicates the fourth month in the project timeline when Oficina 2 takes place.

Cultura de Preservação
Cultura de Preservação is a cultural approach that promotes the preservation and care for the coastal ecosystem through community engagement and education.

CNAE Cultural
João MEI is responsible for verifying the CNAE cultural for compliance with the SALIC project.

engineering team
Karaguá collaborates with the engineering team to discuss technical requirements related to the mangrove for the ecobarrier prototype.

workshops
Tinkercad is suggested for modeling workshops due to its accessibility and ease of use for participants.

methodology
Lucas emphasizes the significance of prototyping concepts and the need for a replicable methodology.
